_comment: UNIRA V6.8: matched-resource comparison of B (reformed market economy) and C (UNIRA). Same targets (30 h week, comfortable level for all), same population, technology, productivity response (theta) and capacities. Only institutional levers differ. Values marked PENDING_VERIFICATION are replaced from ../verification/parameters.json when available.

employment_rate_20_64.basis_B: best observed 20-64 rate in Europe (top-3 mean ~84%: IS, NL, CH) reached by active labour-market policy
employment_rate_20_64.basis_C: rule 14 universal work; above any observed rate (SYNTHETIC beyond observation)

market_specific_activity_cut.basis_B: regulation trims advertising/speculative finance (v63/io modest level)

energy_share_to_regions_in_need.basis_B: VERIFIED: ~20% of global clean-energy investment goes to developing economies excl. China (IEA World Energy Investment 2026, p.202-203; Africa 2%)
energy_share_to_regions_in_need.basis_C: needs-first allocation by the One Earth entity (rules 5, 9)

rich_region_energy_decline.basis_C: convergence within climate envelope with military energy freed (v67)

military_energy_share_freed.basis_C: rule 19; military = 5.5% of global GHG emissions incl. supply chains (CONFIRMED, SGR/CEOBS 2022, range 3.3-7.0%); used as proxy for energy share (no global military energy statistic exists)

health_plan.basis_B: training +7%/yr, no military volunteers, no prevention effect
health_plan.basis_C: ambitious training + 50% of soldiers volunteer + strong prevention (v66)

health_share_to_regions_in_need.basis_B: SYNTHETIC: new workers partly absorbed by richer regions (health-worker migration)

housing_share_to_regions_in_need.basis_B: SYNTHETIC: no source splits new residential construction by income group (UNEP GlobalABC: estimates 'are lacking'); 30% kept as an assumption

B2_ambitious_cooperative_market._comment: Strongest plausible reformed market: large international transfers and climate finance, but militaries, commercial competition and market allocation of labour remain. All values SYNTHETIC (policy scenario).
